Class App

java.lang.Object
imageproof.App
All Implemented Interfaces:
ActionListener, EventListener, ChangeListener
public class App extends Object implements ActionListener, ChangeListener
Main window of the program. It is the last step of the flow Histogram to Comparison to Regions to Noise and Edges to CopyMove and FlatPatch to LocalAnomaly to TamperingAssessment. This class only shows the results.

How it works:

  • Loading: "Open image..." lets the user choose a PNG or JPEG file. LoadedImage.load(File) reads it in a SwingWorker background job.
  • Analyzing: "Analyze" runs Analysis.run(java.awt.image.BufferedImage, String) in another background job, so the window stays responsive. The result is a SHORT final assessment: the outcome, the measured anomalous area and up to three reasons.
  • Job number: every new job gets a new number (jobNumber). When a job finishes, its number is compared with the current one. An old number means a newer job started, so the old result is ignored. This way a slow result from an old image is never shown for a new image.
  • Histogram selection: clicking a tile on the image selects it. The histogram panel then shows that tile's histogram, and a short summary of the selected region is shown (position, size, three measurements and one sentence). The assessment does not change. "Whole-image histogram" goes back.
  • Views: a drop-down list chooses what is drawn on the image (flagged regions, heatmaps, edge map or copy-move candidates).
  • Advanced details: a separate read-only window with the full text: rules, tables for every tile and copy-move counts.

The numbers are measurements, not a verdict. The anomalous-area percentage is a measured area, not a probability of editing. Unusual values do not prove editing, and normal values do not prove that an image is authentic. This program is for learning. It is not forensic proof.
